Chocolate Banana Cookies
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 27, 2009 - 11:51pm

Ingredients




2/3 cup shortening
1 cup sugar
1 egg, well beaten
1 pkg. (6 oz.) semi-sweet morsels
1 teaspoon vanilla
1 cup soft mashed bananas
2 1/4 cups flour
2 teaspoons baking powder
1/4 teaspoon baking soda
1/2 teaspoon salt

Preparation

1 Cream together shortening and sugar. Add egg. Melt chocolate morsels and add vanilla to the chocolate. Add this to mixture and then add bananas. Last add the dry ingredients: flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 13 to 15 minutes.
